summary: Iteration 21 (UX rework + Custom-Agents BETA) tested end-to-end. Backend 10/10 pytest pass (templates=5, tools=6, voices=4, CRUD, invalid-tool→400, missing-prompt→422, test-call BETA, regression /api/agents=5, /api/whatsapp/rules=3, providers dropi+shopify, auth/me). Frontend: login redesign OK (no big Lyan, gradient .login-hero-bg, 3 benefits, hook contains 20-40% and USD 7-9, right col 440px, support footer with correct mailto and wa.me/573144754115). Sidebar Claude-style OK: sidebar-chats appears ONLY on /app; sidebar-support present on every /app/* route. Copilot mascot is 36x36 rounded-full . Agentes wizard: 5 steps flow, all 5 templates render, prompt pre-filled after template pick, save-draft creates POST /custom-agents, testcall returns BETA message with 'Beta — conecta Telnyx y ElevenLabs...', publish sets estado=en_vivo, delete cleans up (final agents list empty). Feedback dialog shows feedback-support with correct email+WhatsApp. Found + fixed one real bug: Sidebar.newThread called api.post('/threads') with no body → 422 on backend; changed to api.post('/threads', {}).

ui_bugs.issue: sidebar-new-chat POST /threads was sent with no body causing 422 (FastAPI requires ThreadCreate body). Fixed by sending {}.

action_items: Optional backend hardening: make POST /api/threads body Optional (accept empty POST) so future no-body clients don't 422. Currently mitigated on frontend.

Consider making the wizard Nav bar sticky inside the panel — at 1920x800 viewport the 'Siguiente' button sits at y=743 (below fold when panel is tall). Force clicks worked but real users on small laptops must scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: custom_agents.py test-call correctly returns beta=true when TELNYX_API_KEY/ELEVEN_API_KEY unset. Good.

Agentes.jsx: activeDraft is a useMemo of editing only — fine. But `setEditing(saved)` after onSaved keeps the wizard bound to the created agent so subsequent 'Publicar' correctly PATCHes instead of re-POST. Verified.
Sidebar newThread bug (fixed) shows a pattern to watch: any FastAPI POST with pydantic body needs a JSON body from the client, even if all fields are optional.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test agents/threads created during runs were deleted; agentes list returns to empty for the empty-state assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 21 backend + frontend green. Only change made outside tests: Sidebar.jsx L50 now sends `api.post('/threads', {})` instead of `api.post('/threads')`. All iter-21 data-testids from the review request verified. Wizard 'Siguiente' button lives near the bottom of the panel — use viewport 1920x1080 (or scrollIntoView) for reliable clicks.
rca of the issue: Sidebar `newThread` bug: FastAPI endpoint POST /api/threads declares `payload: ThreadCreate` as a required body arg. Even though every field of ThreadCreate is Optional, pydantic still requires the body to exist. axios.post(url) with no data sends no body → 422 'Field required loc=body'. Repro: click 'Nueva conversación' in sidebar without fix → no thread added, console 422. Mitigation applied: send `{}` as the body from the frontend.
